messages:
Tara: Quick quarter-check thread for recurring incidents. Patterns we keep seeing: aggressive downscales, KV eviction storms, and surprise model regressions. Need owners + one-line actions we can import to the recurrence board.

Ben: Can we rank by impact/frequency? I pulled 10 recurrences last 8 weeks: downscale=4, eviction=4, model=2. Will post CSV.

Isha: I'll own eviction storms. Short-term: enable hot-prefix caching + ingress batch cap. Rollout: flag -> 1-region canary -> global. Success: 50% drop in cache-related 5xx within 4w.

Rafael: I'll take downscale. Short-term: bump graceful window 30->90s for warm pools and pause downscales during backup windows. Canary pool A 24h -> region -> global. Success: pod churn cut by 60%.

alert-bot: created ticket #INC-2026-1711 "Recurrence follow-up: eviction+downscale" linked to thread

Tara: Paste one-line importable items here (format: owner | action | ETA). Also add 2-3 step oncall mitigations.

Isha: "Isha | enable hot-prefix cache + cap ingress batch | 2026-04-12". Playbook: 1) set cache read-only 2) flip prefix flag 3) scale cache nodes.

Rafael: "Rafael | increase graceful window + backup gating | 2026-04-05". Playbook: 1) increase window 2) disable aggressive downscale 3) move traffic to warm pool.

Ben: I'll map these to customer-impact heatmap and import to the board. ETA for board update: 2026-03-29.

Tara: Confirm in-thread with :white_check_mark: when tasks are posted so I can close the loop. Follow-up sync in 7 days to review canary metrics.

Isha: :white_check_mark:

Rafael: :white_check_mark:

Ben: :white_check_mark:
